docente:ferestrepoca.bio: Associate professor in the Department of Systems and Industrial Engineering and coordinator of the Master's program in Systems and Computing Engineering. He researches how to learn programming better and how to build more dependable software systems: programming education, automated code analysis and the dependability of computing systems.

docente:fagonzalezo.bio: Full professor in the Department of Systems and Industrial Engineering, where he leads the Machine Learning, Perception and Discovery Lab (MindLab). His research focuses on artificial intelligence, machine learning and quantum computing, with an emphasis on the automatic analysis of multimodal data and, more recently, on quantum machine learning algorithms.

docente:capedrazab.bio: Associate professor in the Department of Systems and Industrial Engineering. He works on parallel computing, evolutionary algorithms and operating systems, and within the group he supports the intelligent transportation systems, smart sensing and dependable embedded systems research areas.

docente:jjramireze.bio: Associate professor in the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering. His research focuses on engineering education, particularly self-regulated learning and the learning-to-learn competence, the subject of his doctoral thesis.
